title: Which European country will announce a complete drought-related shutdown of its nuclear power generation between August 1 and August 13, 2026?
background: Nuclear reactors require reliable cooling-water supplies. Low river levels can force reactors to shut down, potentially disrupting national electricity supplies.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official announcements by national nuclear operators or governments, corroborated by reliable news reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Identify the European country that announces, between August 1 and August 13, 2026, a shutdown covering its entire operating nuclear fleet because drought has left insufficient river water for cooling. An announcement initiating the shutdown of the last operating reactor qualifies; a partial shutdown alone does not. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country's common English name.
